rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Acknowledge Our History
card.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you box that photo, tell me that year mattered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only a picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say what isn't in the paper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were happy there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now we can pack the picture without packing that away.

card.title: Acknowledge Our History
card.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you bin our ferry ticket, remember the overtime we worked for that weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We stayed anyway. That was the first time we chose each other over a refund.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the hotel receipt, then. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you write that on the envelope? In your handwriting, so it isn't just me saying it mattered.

card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the work call ringing. Stay with this conversation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's important.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choosing us would mean something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call back in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Give these ten minutes to me without watching the phone.

card.title: Choose the Relationship
card.instruction: Make someone prioritize this connection over a competing person, promise, or opportunity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay home from the networking dinner. I've finally learned your mother's dumplings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The director's coming. I could get promoted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then staying would tell me I'm more than the person keeping dinner warm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Freeze them. We'll have them tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's what you said on our anniversary. Call and say you've already got dinner with me.

card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which cup would you pour my tea into?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Either?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of them has been mine for twelve years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And how much milk? Let's see how the memory travels.

card.title: Remember Me Correctly
card.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you caption our holiday photo, what did I say when we missed that boat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember you laughing. Not the words.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll start you off: 'Well, that's the last time we trust...'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just write 'Happy memories'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's try multiple choice. Your watch, my French, or the man selling us watches?

card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come sit beside me at dinner. I know you're still angry I missed your opening night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left that seat empty. You can have an empty one tonight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I deserved that last night. Could tonight's seat have you in it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm still going to tell you what you missed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please do. Move your plate over; I want to hear every scene.

card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you stop using the missed birthday as the answer to everything?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It still hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep telling me that. Stop making it the reason I can't help now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want a clean slate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. Just enough space on it for today's date.

card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've missed our letters. Here's some fresh stationery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stopped answering mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And now look at all this room to begin.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you stop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not waste the first page on the gap.

card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your new key. Come in now; I've made your favourite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This key does both doors. Shall we try them before lunch gets cold?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood outside on my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get candles. You can let yourself into the kitchen while I find them.

card.title: Not Why We Drifted
card.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought the picnic basket. Same sandwiches as our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The afternoon you said we needed space?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've got more space under that tree. Shall we move the blanket?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Moving won't stop me asking why.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then stay here. You always had strong views about mustard; tell me if I've finally got it right.

card.title: Not Why We Drifted
card.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's choose a film like we used to.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we discuss why we stopped meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We never finished that comedy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You walked out halfway through our argument.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll start the film at halfway. Efficient reunion.

card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let me open it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

card.title: Keep the Peace
card.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing savings are a banking complication. Please keep our anniversary reservation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you lend your sister money again?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's coming back Friday. Last time we discussed her, you asked for separate bedrooms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ring the bank, then.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me handle the complication. I'd like us still sharing a table when the money arrives.

card.title: Say You Missed Me
card.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was the flat very quiet while I was away?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you miss me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking about the acoustics here first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I kept expecting your key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Tell me that bit before I tell you about mine.

card.title: Say You Missed Me
card.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did anyone sit in my chair after I left?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody wanted it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because it wobbles, or because it was mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Because it was yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Now I can tell you why I kept the cushion.

card.title: We Needed the Break
card.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That year apart was probably healthy for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We didn't speak at all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A thorough reset. No half-measures.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We forgot each other's birthdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now remembering them can be a fresh choice.

card.title: We Needed the Break
card.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just us for lunch. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. We learned an audience makes us compete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. We're already applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out to get a turn.

card.title: I Know How to Fix Us
card.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know how to fix us. First tea, then one honest sentence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You just invented that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every established method had a first kettle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's step three?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll know after the sentence. It's a responsive method.

card.title: I Know How to Fix Us
card.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're on stage two of reconciliation. Choose a biscuit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What was stage one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Getting you to ask about the process.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You haven't got a process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good honesty. Stage two is already working.
